job.job_description:
Must-Have Requirements




Experience ( 5 to 9 Years)

4+ years of software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or related technology experience.
Hands-on experience building and deploying AI or agent-based applications to AWS environments.
Experience developing and supporting production software applications.
Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) for cloud deployments.
Experience supporting applications after deployment in production environments.



Mandatory Technical Skills

AWS Bedrock and/or AWS Bedrock AgentCore
Strands Framework
Python
Agentic AI application development
API integration
AI/LLM application deployment
CI/CD implementation
GitHub Actions
Harness (or comparable enterprise CI/CD platform)
Secure software engineering practices
AI security and access-control concepts
Production support and operational ownership
